label: Past-tense narrative prose register
explanation: It fires diffusely across tokens inside past-tense storytelling — fiction, memoir, narrative nonfiction — with no single token reliably triggering it (all conditional rates ≤4%). It is strongest in dense narrative sequences of character action plus speech or thought attribution ("looked at her and said", "began trying to persuade", "I thought"), and stays silent or weak in code, news, transcripts, blog text, and poetry.
